milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must navigate near the light gray wool blocks (centered at spawn-relative -3, 1, 5 on the oak plank platform to the left of the path) and face toward them. max_distance=8 was chosen (reduced from 16 per ValidatorAgent feedback) because the wool is only ~5.8 blocks from spawn horizontally — a distance of 16 would allow triggering from spawn without meaningful navigation. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the wool stack.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must navigate near the chiseled red sandstone structure (centered at spawn-relative 4, 1, 11) and face toward it. max_distance=10 was chosen (reduced from 16 per ValidatorAgent feedback) because the structure is ~11.7 blocks from spawn — a distance of 16 would allow triggering from spawn. At max_distance=10 the player must walk at least 2 blocks along the path. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must navigate near the light gray wall banner (at spawn-relative 4, 2, 13 on the interior back wall of the sandstone structure, facing north) and face toward it. max_distance=8 requires the player to be within ~8 blocks horizontally of the banner — since the banner is ~13.6 blocks from spawn, the player must walk to at least z≈9 (the archway entrance) and look north toward the back wall. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is facing the banner.
